teams.PHI: CHI allows +6% yards per carry and +7% per target vs average. CHI plays man on 39% of charted snaps (league 31%) and blitzes 30% (league 29%). Formations: PHI is in heavy personnel (2+ TE or 2+ RB) on 23% of plays (league 42%); CHI plays a light box on 39% of snaps (league 43%), a stacked box on 23% (league 25%), and nickel/dime on 62% (league 68%). Against PHI's personnel, expect 38% light and 23% stacked boxes -> PHI run efficiency −0.1%. Targets: tight ends +5.3%, backs +2.2% (receivers give up the difference), because CHI is in base personnel more than usual against PHI's 3-WR looks, so linebackers cover backs and tight ends more often; and heavy personnel against nickel/dime, which puts a defensive back on the tight end, should come up less than usual in this game.
teams.CHI: PHI plays man on 40% of charted snaps (league 31%) and blitzes 26% (league 29%). Formations: CHI is in heavy personnel (2+ TE or 2+ RB) on 54% of plays (league 42%); PHI plays a light box on 52% of snaps (league 43%), a stacked box on 17% (league 25%), and nickel/dime on 75% (league 68%). Against CHI's personnel, expect 49% light and 22% stacked boxes -> CHI run efficiency +0.5%. Targets: tight ends −4.3%, backs −1.8% (receivers give up the difference), because PHI is in base personnel less than usual against CHI's 3-WR looks, so linebackers cover backs and tight ends less often; and PHI often answers CHI's heavy sets with nickel/dime, putting a defensive back on the tight end.
